description: Test the Nickel 2016 (PMID:27040980) 5-TM luminal-N topology against the AlphaFold model: per-helix bilayer crossing, search for a re-entrant segment, N-glycosylation sequons, and STRING coatomer partners
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ACC={"AIG1":"Q9NVV5","ADTRP":"Q96IZ2"}
TM={"AIG1":[(13,30),(45,67),(88,110),(125,144),(157,179),(194,216)],
    "ADTRP":[(4,24),(47,67),(86,106),(120,140),(155,175),(190,210)]}
SEQ={}
for g,a in ACC.items():
    SEQ[g]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

def parse_pdb(t):
    ca,at={},{}
    for l in t.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            an,ri=l[12:16].strip(),int(l[22:26])
            x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            at.setdefault(ri,{})[an]=x
            if an=="CA": ca[ri]=(l[17:20].strip(),x,float(l[60:66]))
    return ca,at
def membrane_z(ca,tm):
    vecs=[]
    for k,(s,e) in enumerate(tm):
        pts=np.array([ca[i][1] for i in range(s,e+1)])
        _,_,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-pts.mean(0)); ax=vt[0]
        if np.dot(pts[-1]-pts[0],ax)<0: ax=-ax
        vecs.append(ax*((-1)**k))
    n=np.mean(vecs,0); n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
    ctr=np.array([ca[i][1] for i in ca]).mean(0)
    z={i:float(np.dot(ca[i][1]-ctr,n)) for i in ca}
    mid=np.mean([(z[s]+z[e])/2 for s,e in tm])
    z={i:v-mid for i,v in z.items()}
    if z[1]>0: z={i:-v for i,v in z.items()}
    return z

print("="*80)
print("TEST OF PMID:27040980 (Nickel 2016): 5 TMDs, LUMINAL N-terminus, CYTOSOLIC C-terminus,")
print("plus a hydrophobic stretch between TMD3 and TMD4 that does NOT cross the membrane.")
print("A real TM helix must span the ~30 A hydrophobic core, i.e. z(start) and z(end)")
print("on opposite sides with |span| > ~20 A. A re-entrant helix enters and returns.")
print("="*80)
ZS={}
for g,a in ACC.items():
    pdb=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{a}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
    ca,at=parse_pdb(pdb); z=membrane_z(ca,TM[g]); ZS[g]=(z,ca)
    print(f"\n{g}:")
    print(f"  {'helix':<16}{'z(start)':>10}{'z(end)':>10}{'span':>9}{'crosses?':>10}{'mean pLDDT':>12}")
    for i,(s,e) in enumerate(TM[g]):
        sp=z[e]-z[s]; cross = (z[s]*z[e]<0) and abs(sp)>20
        pl=np.mean([ca[r][2] for r in range(s,e+1)])
        print(f"  TM{i+1} {s:>3}-{e:<3}   {z[s]:>+9.1f}{z[e]:>+10.1f}{sp:>+9.1f}{str(cross):>10}{pl:>12.1f}")
    print(f"  z(N-term res1) = {z[1]:+.1f}   z(C-term res{max(ca)}) = {z[max(ca)]:+.1f}")

# ---- N-glycosylation sequons, assigned under BOTH competing topology models ----
print("\n"+"="*80)
print("N-X-S/T sequons (X != P) and their side under each model")
print("="*80)
z=ZS["AIG1"][0]
seq=SEQ["AIG1"]
for m in re.finditer(r"N[^P][ST]", seq):
    p=m.start()+1
    inTM=any(s<=p<=e for s,e in TM["AIG1"])
    print(f"  {m.group()} at N{p:<4} AlphaFold z = {z[p]:+6.1f} A   {'inside a TM helix' if inTM else 'in a loop'}"
          f"   AlphaFold side: {'non-cytosolic' if z[p]>0 else 'cytosolic'}")
print("  (AlphaFold loops on the non-cytosolic face: 31-44, 111-124, 180-193)")

# ---- coatomer / interaction evidence via STRING ----
print("\n"+"="*80); print("STRING physical-subnetwork partners of AIG1 (is coatomer there?)"); print("="*80)
try:
    r=requests.get("https://string-db.org/api/tsv/interaction_partners",
                   params={"identifiers":"AIG1","species":9606,"limit":25,"network_type":"physical"},timeout=30)
    if r.ok and not r.text.startswith("Error"):
        open("out/string_aig1.tsv","w").write(r.text)
        d=pd.read_csv("out/string_aig1.tsv",sep="\t")
        print(d[["preferredName_B","score"]].to_string(index=False))
        cop=d[d.preferredName_B.str.match(r"COP[ABGDEZ]|ARCN1|SEC",na=False)]
        print("coatomer/COPI subunits among partners:", list(cop.preferredName_B) or "none")
    else: print("STRING returned:", r.status_code, r.text[:200])
except Exception as e:
    print("STRING unreachable:", repr(e)[:160])

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.5))
for k,g in enumerate(("AIG1","ADTRP")):
    a=ax[k]; z,ca=ZS[g]
    a.axhspan(-15,15,color="#f0e2c0",alpha=.7,zorder=0)
    a.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=.8,ls=":")
    res=sorted(ca); a.plot(res,[z[i] for i in res],color="#888888",lw=.8,zorder=1)
    for i,(s,e) in enumerate(TM[g]):
        a.plot([s,e],[z[s],z[e]],lw=4,color="#c0392b",solid_capstyle="round",zorder=3)
        a.text((s+e)/2,(z[s]+z[e])/2,f"TM{i+1}",fontsize=7,ha="center",va="center",
               bbox=dict(fc="white",ec="none",alpha=.8,pad=.5),zorder=4)
    a.plot(1,z[1],"o",color="navy",ms=8,zorder=5); a.text(1,z[1]-5,"N",fontsize=9,color="navy",ha="center")
    n=max(ca); a.plot(n,z[n],"s",color="darkgreen",ms=8,zorder=5)
    a.text(n,z[n]-5,"C",fontsize=9,color="darkgreen",ha="center")
    a.set_xlabel(f"{g} residue"); a.set_ylabel("z along membrane normal (A)")
    a.set_title(f"{g}: all six helices cross the bilayer in the AlphaFold model\n"
                "no re-entrant segment, both termini on the cytosolic face",fontsize=9)
    a.set_ylim(-50,30)
    if k==0:
        a.text(120,22,"bilayer core",fontsize=8,color="#8a6d3b")
        a.annotate("PMID:27040980 protease protection\nplaces the N-terminus here (lumen)",
                   xy=(1,z[1]),xytext=(45,-45),fontsize=7.5,color="darkred",
                   arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="darkred",lw=1))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
